task_text: Open the lid of the thermal cycler, which starts closed and locked: turn the lever on the lid back from its locked end (0.94 rad of travel) and swing the lid fully open (1.9 rad). Success the moment the lid and its lever are both within 0.003 rad of their fully open end positions.

inventory: thermal cycler (Bio-Rad C1000 model) with a hinged lid, a locking lever on the lid and a force knob
